entities.summary:
Damocrates (b. 100 CE, Athens) was a renowned physician and medical pioneer of the Classical era, active in Athens.

As a key figure in the medical community, Damocrates contributed significantly to the understanding and treatment of various diseases.

His work, although not widely recognized in his lifetime, had a lasting impact on the development of medicine in the ancient world.
